title: Visibility graphs can make money in financial markets

extraction.methodology_summary: The Visibility Graphs Relative Strength Index (VGRSI) is constructed by transforming backward visibility relations in a price time series into upward and downward price change sums and frequency counts within a rolling window. The strategy uses a 30-day optimisation window and a 7-day walk-forward test window to evaluate long and short entries based on predefined thresholds. It is tested on automated trading platforms using minute and 30-minute bar data over a 2024-2025 sample.

performance_metrics.evidence_quote: The strategy based on VGRSI signals generated a profit of USD 146,000 for DJI30, USD 69,000 for EUR/USD, and USD 125,000 for XAU/USD.

key_findings: The Visibility Graphs Relative Strength Index (VGRSI) successfully generates profitable trading signals across different asset classes by capturing geometric and temporal price patterns.
The strategy produced a combined profit of approximately USD 340,000 across DJI30, EUR/USD, and XAU/USD over 503 trading days.
The strategy maintains high Sharpe ratios ranging between 2.55 and 3.6 with moderate drawdowns between 10% and 18%.
limitations: The study covered only three financial instruments.
Testing was performed using a fixed single-trade value of USD 1,000 and a limit of two simultaneously open positions.
